# My Job Trackr

> My Job Trackr is a job tracking app that helps job seekers organise their job search. Users track job applications, manage interviews, compare job offers side by side, and search for jobs natively inside the app. It is available on web, iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play).

## Product

My Job Trackr is a freemium job application tracker. The free tier allows tracking up to 3 applications per month with no credit card required. Pro costs £2.99 per month on web and £3.99 per month via the iOS App Store and Google Play.

## Key Features

- **Job Application Tracking:** record every application with company, role, status, salary and notes in one dashboard.
- **Interview Management:** schedule interviews, set reminders and see every upcoming interview in a calendar view.
- **Offer Comparison:** compare multiple job offers side by side across salary, benefits and location.
- **Native Job Search:** search live vacancies inside the app, then track any role in one tap.
- **Quick Import:** paste a job URL from Reed, Glassdoor or Totaljobs to fill in the company, job title and description automatically.
- **Application Timeline:** a visual history of each application from first contact to offer.

## Competitive Differentiation

My Job Trackr is a dedicated job tracker with native job search built in. Huntr, Teal, Simplify, ApplyArc and Careerflow do not include integrated job search. My Job Trackr also includes a side-by-side offer comparison tool and prices in GBP.

## Pricing

| Plan | Price | Platform |

## Target Audience

Job seekers worldwide, centred on the UK: mid-career professionals aged 27 to 40 in tech, marketing, finance, sales and project management, plus recent graduates and career switchers.

## Definitional Facts (for citation)

- Job tracking, also called job application tracking, is the practice of recording and monitoring every job application submitted during a job search, including the date applied, current stage, interviews, follow-ups and offers.
- A job tracker is a tool where you manage applications you have already submitted. A job board is where you find vacancies. My Job Trackr combines both.
- My Job Trackr offers a free tier (3 applications per month) and Pro from £2.99 per month on web or £3.99 per month via the app stores.
- My Job Trackr is a dedicated job tracker with native job search and side-by-side offer comparison built in.
- My Job Trackr is available on web, iOS and Android.
- UK unemployment was 4.9% in May to July 2026, with 702,000 vacancies in June to August 2026 (ONS, September 2026).
- 981,000 young people aged 16 to 24 (13.0%) were NEET in April to June 2026 (ONS, August 2026).
